title: Business connections
text: Work with your service providers and your clients on the platform: each side sees only what the client shares.

grants.title: What they may do in your data
grants.hint_client: Switch on a module and tick what they may do in it. Only the shared factories, only these actions; you can take it back at any time.
grants.hint_provider: What the client lets your company do in its shared factories.
grants.none_grantable: None of your modules can be given here. Turn on a module first.
grants.none_given: The client has not given you any module yet.
grants.revoke_text: {name} loses it at once, also in a screen already open. What they did stays in your data and your log.

work.title: Work in this client's factory
work.text: You see and do only what the client gave. Everything you change shows in their log, with your name.

empty.clients_text: Invite a client: give them the code, and they choose which of their factories you may work for.
empty.providers_text: Has a service provider given you a connection code? Enter it and choose which factories they may work for.

invite.title: Invite a client
invite.text: You get a code to give your client. They enter it in their own account and choose which factories you may work for.
invite.note_hint: Only you see it, e.g. Rider Group.
invite.give: Give this code to your client (by phone, email or in person):
invite.copy_failed: Could not copy: select the code and copy it by hand.
invite.once: Shown only now. It can be used once, until {date}.

accept.title: Connect with a service provider
accept.text: Enter the code your service provider gave you. You choose which of your companies and branches they may work for.

units.title: Factories they may work for
units.hint: Tick companies or branches. A ticked company includes its branches.

drawer.title: Connection
drawer.paused_by_you: You paused this connection: nothing goes either way until you resume it.
drawer.paused_by_them: The other side paused this connection: nothing goes either way until they resume it.

steps.pause_text: Nothing can be sent either way until you resume it. What each side has stays.
steps.end_text: This cannot be undone: nothing more can be sent. What each side received stays theirs. The other side is told your reason.
